column1: # 333: exordia = origins (fixed; 2.1062 already). 336-337: multa parum = few (Bailey, Munro); refrain with 2.694, 2.723-724.
# 451-452: secondary accepted (the relative clause belongs to the liquids). 364: species not "shapes".

column2: and what has been wont to be born will be born under the same
and the lambs, filled full, play and gently butt their heads;
Come now, next learn of what sort the origins
not that few are endowed with a like form,
but because, as a rule, not all are alike to all.
nor can the sight of other calves in the glad pastures
